purpose: Truth-free raw Android inter-signal-bias consumption and sign audit for FullInterSignalBiasNanos and SatelliteInterSignalBiasNanos on four route-disjoint Pixel5 recordings. No implementation or estimator rerun is authorized until every fixed identifiability gate passes.

objective.factor: raw Android FullInterSignalBiasNanos + SatelliteInterSignalBiasNanos current consumption/sign

phase59_result.use: factor selection and policy metadata only; no Phase59 metric payload is an audit input

phase58_structural_result.use: route/input provenance and prior structural policy only; no Phase58 metric payload is an audit input

phase25_raw_contract.use: raw-clock pseudorange proxy contract only; no Phase25 metric payload or enriched coordinates

full_inter_signal_bias.meaning: sum of estimated receiver-side and space-segment-side inter-system, inter-frequency, and inter-code biases relative to GnssClock reference constellation; inter-frequency ionospheric bias is excluded

satellite_inter_signal_bias.meaning: space-segment-side inter-system, inter-frequency, and inter-code bias including master-clock/group-delay/DCB components relative to GnssClock reference constellation

source_semantics.composition_rule: FullInterSignalBiasNanos already includes the space-segment terms represented by SatelliteInterSignalBiasNanos; Full minus Satellite is the receiver-side remainder. Full plus Satellite is not a source-defined correction and must never be applied.
source_semantics.metres_conversion: bias_m = c * bias_nanos * 1e-9, c=299792458 m/s; parse decimal text exactly before conversion and retain signed value
source_semantics.raw_pseudorange_proxy: segment_base=first valid FullBiasNanos; receiver GPST nanoseconds=TimeNanos-segment_base; week=floor(clock_ns/1e9/604800); tow_rx=(clock_ns-week*604800e9)/1e9-BiasNanos/1e9-TimeOffsetNanos/1e9; tow_tx=ReceivedSvTimeNanos/1e9 with the existing constellation day/offset contract; P_raw=(tow_rx-tow_tx)*c after nearest-week unwrap
source_semantics.proxy_scope: current adopted pseudorange proxy rows means Raw rows with supported signal/frequency, finite Phase25 raw-clock P in (10000000,40000000) m, existing code/CN0/multipath/status masks clear, and no enriched RawPseudorangeMeters, WLS, SvPosition, SvElevation, nav, or coordinate input
source_semantics.pair_observable: same utcTimeMillis epoch and same constellation/Svid with two distinct supported signal tokens/frequency groups; no nearest-time/interpolation
source_semantics.common_mode: within each utcTimeMillis plus HardwareClockDiscontinuityCount group, subtract the finite row median of each signed bias and retain the raw signed value, centered value, and non-common residual
source_semantics.time_stability: within each route and field, sort finite adopted rows by raw UTC key and report adjacent signed-bias changes only when the field exists at both endpoints; a discontinuity is a finite adjacent change above the predeclared jump gate, not a fitted correction
source_semantics.sign_policy: use Android's documented subtraction sign exactly; opposite sign is a fixed diagnostic control only and cannot be selected from route data
source_semantics.implementation_candidate_if_authorized: FGO undifferenced pseudorange only: P_corrected=P_raw-c*FullInterSignalBiasNanos*1e-9; SatelliteInterSignalBiasNanos is retained as provenance/decomposition and is not added; coefficient=1, no cap, no SPP/TDCP/Doppler

controls_and_repeats.control: uncorrected raw pair delta and opposite-sign diagnostic; no data-selected sign, threshold, or factor is fitted
controls_and_repeats.primary: Android-source-sign Full and Satellite corrected pair deltas plus signed per-row bias distributions
controls_and_repeats.full_vs_satellite_decomposition: report Full, Satellite, and Full-minus-Satellite receiver-side remainder separately; never report Full-plus-Satellite as a candidate
controls_and_repeats.common_mode_control: same-epoch median-centered signed bias and pair residual; route-level common offsets are not treated as geometry evidence
controls_and_repeats.route_leave_one_out: recompute pooled medians, materiality, pair consistency, and non-common direction after omitting each route from already-held in-memory rows; no second raw read
controls_and_repeats.repeat_policy: one raw read per route in one process; deterministic summaries and aggregate invariants are recomputed from that in-memory parse only

numeric_gates.logic: AND; all thresholds, formulas, field-availability rules, and sign policy are immutable after this freeze and before the first Phase60 raw read

failure_policy.any_gate_failure: record fail-closed raw-only no-go, do not implement or rerun solver, preserve all route/read/hash accounting, and name exactly one next source-supported raw physical factor
failure_policy.missing_or_ambiguous_fields: hard no-go for correction; report header presence, finite availability, and ambiguity without zero-filling
failure_policy.source_sign: never fit or reverse sign from observed route data; use the Android subtraction equation
failure_policy.full_satellite_double_count: Full plus Satellite is prohibited; if an implementation stage is authorized it may apply Full only and retain Satellite as provenance
failure_policy.if_all_gates_pass: freeze a separate native implementation contract before source edits, then run only truth-free focused tests and structural matrix; stop before any accuracy truth
failure_policy.next_single_factor_if_no_go: raw Android pseudorange code tracking / multipath residual calibration not already masked by the current adapter
